sam: quick flag: onboarding sampleapp rerank pipeline crashed in staging. root cause looks like mixed embed dims + retry duplication. Node runner emitted 1536-d vectors, Python runner 1024-d. rerank helper assumes 1024 and fails on reshape. also saw duplicate items when token refresh happened mid-batch. anyone seen this exact combo?
neha: hm. what model id + env? could be quant selector differences between runtimes.
sam: config sets MODEL=open-embed-1024. Node container has EMBED_QUANT=1 so node sdk picks a q4 variant at runtime `open-embed-1536-q4`. Python runner (no EMBED_QUANT) returns `open-embed-1024`. small batch of 3 inputs; sampleapp splits logical batch into two http calls. when a 401 came back on the first call, sdk retried the whole logical batch and both original + retry landed. downstream saw 6 vectors (3x1024 + 3x1536) and reshape crashed.
leo: two issues: (A) parity: node quant selector should not silently change model dim; (B) retry/idempotency: SDK retries need to be idempotent at logical-batch level or sampleapp should attach deterministic idempotency keys across splits.
sam: logs:```
[2026-04-15T08:22:11Z] POST /v1/embeddings batch=lb-900 status=401 token=expired
[2026-04-15T08:22:12Z] auth refresh ok
[2026-04-15T08:22:12Z] RETRY POST /v1/embeddings batch=lb-900 idempotency=none status=200 model=open-embed-1536-q4
[2026-04-15T08:22:12Z] python-runner callback status=200 model=open-embed-1024
```
neha: short term: add defensive dedupe keyed by input id/hash in rerank helper before reshape, and assert all responses declare same vector_dim/model_id. Also patch sampleapp batcher to attach a deterministic Idempotency-Key per logical batch so retries don't duplicate.
leo: long term SDK change: include explicit `vector_dim` and `model_id` fields in the embeddings response envelope. callers shouldn't infer dim by length. also ensure node quant selector respects explicit config (or exposes when it switches variants).
sam: I'll open three PRs: 1) sampleapp batching idempotency glue, 2) rerank helper dedupe + assert + clearer error, 3) node-sdk parity test and bug report for quant path. I'll include an integration test simulating 401 mid-batch.
devex-bot: reminder: add unit test that simulates partial 401 and verifies SDK retry is idempotent for batched embeds.
infra-watch: monitoring added for embed-shape-errors > 0.1% for 60m. ping if spike.
neha: for docs: add onboarding note that EMBED_QUANT or runtime selectors can change model variant/dim and to pin `force_variant` if you need consistent dims across runtimes. I'll add to migration guide.
sam: thanks — will post PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:
